reviews.text: Love the place staff was so friendly will be coming again for my cats check up. Thank you!!

I had a great experience here with my dog! From the moment I booked the appointment to when I walked in the front door. The front desk staff was welcoming, professional and quick to take back my dog. Once in the exam room the vet tech and the vet were quick, precise, and walked me through the process so it made me feel confident of what the visit consisted of. Price was reasonable (of course it helps that I have insurance) especially for an expensive city like San Diego. When it came to discharge instructions the vet tech was so thorough in explaining everything to me with how to administer the meds I would be going home with for my fur baby. Overall I’m so happy I’ve decided to establish care here for my dog! We left with a great experience, especially knowing my dog was in good hands with a compassionate team.
Every time we go they are so helpful and it doesn’t seem like they’re trying to get as much money as they can like it does the other vets we’ve been to so kind and helpful and informative!

Outstanding service with flexible hours. Great savings available through their "Puppy Package"
We have been coming here for 6 years now and we are still thrilled with the personal care and attention our dog receives. You won't find a better pet care facility in San Diego.  VERY REASONABLY PRICED!

Update 04/26/2020 - We are extremely satisfied with the love, comfort, support and care Esteban is receiving. I wouldn't begin to go some other place. The entire Pet Hospital is awesome.

Esteban is 7 years old now. There isn't another Pet Hospital I would trust with his care. Everyone one here is so helpful, concerned and caring.
Very understanding and compassionate to our nervous Nellie! Her spay went so smooth and their follow ups via text and call have been very convenient

All the staff here are wonderful. The front desk girls are so sweet and helpful. Dr. Michelle D’Angelo is amazing and is very accommodating. The techs are just as great and very patient explaining everything to me. 10/10 recommend to everyone who has dogs and cats.

I can't say enough good things about Tide and Tail Veterinary Clinic! From the moment you walk through the door, the staff makes you and your pet feel like family. The entire team—from the welcoming receptionists to the attentive veterinary assistants is incredibly warm, professional, and compassionate.
Dr. Collaca is absolute magic with animals. She takes her time, listens thoroughly, and genuinely cares about the well-being of her patients. Her calm, knowledgeable approach completely put my pet at ease during our visit. You can tell she truly loves what she does and having a vet you trust implicitly makes all the difference.
On top of the outstanding care, the facility itself is beautiful, clean, and modern. It’s bright, fresh, and thoughtfully designed to keep pets calm and comfortable. Plus, you can't beat the location right in Leucadia. it's super convenient and fits perfectly into the coastal vibe of the neighborhood.
If you are looking for top-notch care, a gorgeous space, and a team that will treat your pet like their own, I cannot recommend Dr. Collaca and the team at Tide and Tail enough!

Odd waiting for estimate on price of a test for ear infection. Seems standard.  Then waiting on estimate on cause of action for results of test.
Isn't there a standard price for the test.  Ie "The test costs... " "Then once we know what it is we can discuss treatment"  But I waited 15 minutes for estimate of the test itself.  Felt like a timeshare experience. Sad

I came in with my senior dog who had a swollen jaw, it ended up being a large tumor. I knew my dog didn't have much time left (she's almost 17yrs) amd the staff amd veterinarian were all so kind and understanding and made the difficult appointment easier. I was so impressed by their knowledge and approach and we fell their empathy and concern.

The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta has been a favorite vet office for many years. The staff and Dr. D’Angelo were wonderful with my senior dog.

I recently brought my new puppy to their office. She was very calm during her exam and the vaccines she received. It was a good experience for both of us. I highly recommend this vet office.

I drive from the southern most zip code in San Diego county to get my cats and dogs to the Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta.  This location was close by when I lived in the Mission Valley area and there are many veterinary places in the South Bay but I trust the staff, especially Angela at the front desk, to be fair, honest and straight with what my pets need.  I was laughing this morning watching my 15 year old pound puppy HOP thru our lawn that desperately needs mowed - without the care that she has been given at this pet hospital,  I have no doubt that she would not be the healthy, super happy “hopping in tall grass” girl that she is!  Thank you!

My newly adopted dog Rory and I have found our vet home!!  We love Dr Kara Johnson and the entire staff at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta!  They were all very attentive and obviously all animal lovers!!
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Kelly. Thank you so much for the great review!
Hi, Lesly. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta!
This is a wonderful vet clinic. They're very well organized, affordable, professional, and caring. My dog is already doing better!
Great 1st visit at Tierrasanta Pet Hospital. Dr. Barnes was amazing, got very involved in my dog Scooby’s best interest. Could not be more happy with this Pet Hospital. Thank You
Hi, Chris. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta!
We have had the pleasure to get services at the Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta for years ,and we love how they know how to treat my furry baby 😍 …

I turned to them in a time of need and they were there.

Long story short, our dog suffered injuries when he escaped the pet sitter, he was seen by a pet hospital but needed immediate follow up care. Our old vet, also in tierrasanta, said they couldn't fit us in for at least a week.

I called the Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta and they were super helpful over the phone and made room for us the next day for the bandage swap. We've been back sine then and they always treat our dog well and have such a warm caring attitude.

Everyone is super nice and accommodating for my elderly rescue dog, who tends to be a rather fussy (and loud/barking) patient. The assistants and doctors are so gentle and understanding of my pup's apprehensions. Thank you! ❤️

They take great care of my cat! It’s quite far from where I live, but it’s worth it for the kindness and availability (even when I call last-minute, they’ve been able to get us an appointment fairly quickly).

Dr. Elliott and her team are wonderful. She has fantastic bedside manner and takes real time to explain what’s going on with my dog instead of rushing through the visit. You can tell she genuinely cares!

Special shoutout to:
• Laura - always so patient on the phone, even when I call with a dozen questions
• Jessie has an amazing memory; she remembers my dog every single time and always makes her feel comfortable

Highly recommend this practice if you’re looking for a vet team that actually cares about your pet!
Staff was courteous, knowledgeable, capable & explained the dental procedure and results clearly.
Everyone was attentive and patient, didn't feel rushed at all, very welcoming environment
Always a great experience when we go! The staff treats my pup with so much love and care so I feel that he is in good hands. Great customer service as well!
We have always had a good experience here. 10/10

The communication and follow up is absolutely amazing! To get personal calls from the doctor and staff in this day and age is something that goes above and beyond. Appreciated the straightforward information and discussion about planning as my great big Doggo gets older. Great staff great team highly recommend!
Our pets love The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta! Best staff we have ever encountered !!

Dr. D’Angelo and her staff are amazing! My cats were not fans of their vet visits until coming to see her!! Both of my cats feel at home in her office and receive the best care and she always puts any stress I have at ease. We love The Pet Hospital of TTown!!
Very efficient and reasonably priced Veterinarian services.  They did a fine job of diagnosing my dogs issues and provided  great care.

We just moved to the area and was looking for a  local veterinarian to care for our cat. Coming from a small town on the east coast and having personal experience , I was concerned about finding a pet hospital that wasn’t booked up for weeks, potentially months. The staff were very friendly and transparent in terms of pricing before any procedure. They gave the owner options to discuss and choose what’s best for our pet. A few days after the visit, we received a follow up phone call to see how our cat was doing and provided an opportunity to ask any questions. Even though it was my first visit, I was very impressed by Dr. Johnson and all the staff. I will continue my business with them in the future.

It was very important for us to find a vet clinic around us that would give cats the same grace and care as dogs (cat owners know there’s a lot of prejudice with felines). Here at Tierrasanta they were so communicative and diligent with the way they treated my girls. They answered all our questions and they did not seek any way in adding more service to our care to rack up the bill. Their prices are very considerate keeping in mind I spent the same total at a vet in Tijuana but without the 40 min. drive. Front desk, vet tech and doctors were very friendly and gave us a lot of reassurance.

Great experience over the years. The team is is positive, respectful, and kind. Several people connected with me on this visit today and they all were kind and helpful.

Thanks for taking great care of my dog and I!

I would highly recommend this vet to anyone searching around. We have had the best experience, they are awesome!! I've been bringing my dog there since she was a puppy and they have always been so attentive and caring. They are very thorough during appointments and show you all the pricing beforehand. They even call a few days after appointments to make she was still doing good. Every person I've met that works there has been so kind and they just have a very positive atmosphere going on. My dog, Sandia, even gets excited to see them which is awesome to have her not scared of the vet.
5 stars isn't enough, I'd give them 10!
My puupy had an accident and I called the office,  they gave appointment right away.  Stuff is very polite,  doctor was great and helpful.
The Pet Hospital in Tierrasanta is the BEST!! They're a caring, kind, considerate staff and I trust them with our precious cats...Artemis and Apollo!
Dr. D'Angelo truly cared about my dog and not about money. It was refreshing to finally find a vet that wants whats best for your pet and not just money hungry.

Very efficient and welcoming. The veterinary assistant was lovely and Dr. D’Angelo was a pleasure to work with as well. Both my cats had fleas and bite wounds and we got them the care they needed as well as a Costco prescription. 10/10!

Even though I live a little further away I really love bringing my baby girl Lucy here. My most recent visit the staff was super sweet and the vet was so personable. Both the vet and the assistant followed up with me and she’s on the mend. Highly highly recommend 🐶 …
The doctors at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta are warm, caring and provide very personal attention to their patients. Their focus made me feel as though my kitty was their only patient
Very clean office. Very  caring Dr and office staff.

Horrible.  Did not do any good and I would like a refund
My dog is still hurting
Excellent place to taked your pet. Dr. Houston is terrific and caring individual. The team is very good and helpful also. I would highly recommend them.

We absolutely love bringing our dog, Maisie, here! The staff is so kind, patient, and truly caring — they always make us (and Maisie!) feel comfortable and well taken care of. The vets take the time to explain everything clearly and you can tell they genuinely love what they do. We also love Angela at the front desk and she always is so great with our crazy girl. We’re so grateful to have found such a wonderful and trustworthy place for pet care!
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Linda. Thank you so much for the review!

We’ve been taking our French Bulldog, Deacon, to The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta since he was just 3 months old, he’s now 4½, and we wouldn’t go anywhere else. The entire team has always taken incredible care of him, and somehow, Deacon actually gets excited to go to the vet (which says a lot!).

They treat him like a total rockstar every time he walks through the door. His current vet, Dr. D’Angelo, is fantastic! Caring, thorough, and always gives great advice. The team (Angela & Jackie to name a few - there are others!!) is also incredibly responsive and follows up after appointments to check in on how Deacon’s doing, which means a lot. We always feel welcome when we walk in and know that Deacon is getting the best care possible every single time.

Highly recommend this amazing team to anyone who wants their pet treated like family.
Hi, Jacqueline. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta! Can't wait to take care of Lazarus for all his future needs.
Excellent people,  help and education!  Definitely recommend!

I have no notes, just extreme praise for the vet techs and the Dr. D’Angelo. The service and care at the Pet Hospital is truly second to none. I cannot recommend this hospital enough for ALL pet owners! They have my business for as long as I am in Tierrasanta.
Marina, we are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time and leaving us a great review.

Dr D'Angelo and all her staff are extremely helpful, supportive and caring. It's nice to have such confidence in the team that takes care of your fur babies. I'd recommend The Pet Hospital to anyone looking for a great veterinarian for their pets.

We are so grateful to the whole team at The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta for helping us with our dog Bella. Dr. Deangelo made an accurate diagnosis quickly and efficiently, and the entire staff went above and beyond to help us during a stressful time. We couldn’t have asked for better support, and we highly recommend this compassionate and skilled team!
Danielle, Thank you so much for the great review! We really appreciate it.
We appreciate your feedback, Amanda. If you would like to discuss your experience further, don't hesitate to reach out to us at (858) 569-7777. We would love the opportunity to resolve any issues.

Dear Cheryl,

We're sorry to hear that you had a frustrating experience. Our priority is always the health and well-being of the pets entrusted to our care.

We understand that unexpected veterinary expenses can be stressful. However, surgical procedures—especially those involving mass removal—require proper planning, sterile conditions, and a full surgical team to ensure your pet’s safety, and time to monitor recovery. Attempting to remove a mass with a rubber band is extremely dangerous and can lead to serious complications, including infection and unnecessary pain.

Our team always aims to provide transparent, medically sound recommendations. While we regret that we weren’t able to meet your expectations this time, we remain committed to offering ethical, high-quality care to every patient.

The very good organization of Frosted Faces paid about $800 for treatment of scabies on my dog and she was incorrectly diagnosed and therefore still has scabies $800 later. We are homeless and this was her only chance to heal now I'll probably have to have her put down when it gets too bad. The medicines did give her a window of relief for a couple weeks, but she started itching the day after they ran out because despite being told the antiparasitic medicine was for mites also it was not listed on the medicines label..
Obviously incompetent skin scraping doesn't see what is under the skin a quick googling of how to do it may improve your incompetence. Obviously big pharma is your sugar daddy.  Now I'll just watch my dog suffer, thanks  for very little help and a very large bill.
Overpriced and staff was not friendly.
Just a phenomenal place, cares for their patients and owners.
The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta is the best. Staff is always supper friendly and helpful. Dr D’Angelo is so kind, patient, and knowledgeable.  Would highly recommend them.

No longer using Tierrasanta pet hospital! They are not  a full service vet office.  Specifically, animal export papers for international travel. They did them for me for many years but recently told me no, and that they are longer doing export papers.  Instead I went to Tierrasanta veterinary Hospital (similar name) on Tierrasanta blvd! Dr was able to help me at a reasonable price and without issue in a very professional manner!
Love the staff and vets here. Very professional but more importantly caring to our pets.
Great vet hospital! They did a nice job on Penny’s bump removal from her nose.

We were extremely disappointed with our experience here with Dr. D’Angelo. I brought in my 4-month-old Shiba Inu puppy, Niko, for his final round of vaccinations, and instead of completing the visit, Dr. D’Angelo refused to vaccinate him, claiming he was “too aggressive.”

However, this assessment didn’t make sense—Niko allowed the staff to hold him into the back room, let me pick him up afterward, and showed no signs of true aggression. What’s worse, he was so scared that he even pooped himself—which is a clear sign of fear, not aggression.

To make matters worse, Dr. D’Angelo also refused to microchip him, saying that the needle was “too big” and that he should wait until he’s neutered and under anesthesia. This is completely unnecessary—countless puppies get microchipped without sedation, and at only 11 lbs as of today, he is by no means too small for a standard microchip procedure.

Even the vet tech seemed too afraid to weigh him properly, which further showed a lack of confidence in handling a very normal, slightly nervous puppy.

Because of this, I had to take him elsewhere the same day. I went to VetCo, where the staff and veterinarian, Dr. Harrod, handled him confidently and without any issues. Niko was so comfortable that he let them hold him the entire time during his shots and didn’t even flinch during the vaccines or microchip. He was so relaxed that after the appointment, he didn’t even want to leave—he just laid there on the table asking for belly rubs! The only time he reacted at all was to the oral vaccine, which apparently tastes like banana.

This experience made it crystal clear that the issue was not my puppy—it was the way Dr. D’Angelo and her staff handled the situation. A skilled and confident vet should be able to manage a nervous puppy without refusing care.

I wouldn’t recommend this clinic for owners of independent or nervous breeds, as they seem unequipped to handle them properly. Thankfully, I found a vet who could, but I wouldn’t want another pet owner to go through the same unnecessary stress. No vet anywhere should EVER refer to a dog as "bad" let alone an 11lb, 4month old puppy.

Dr. D’Angelo and her staff are professional and great with our dog. My only issue with them is that they mention our dog’s weight *every* appointment yet they don’t offer any advice on how to lower her weight. It’s literally becoming the running theme of every appointment. It’s annoying. Our primary vet helped me calculate caloric intake and offered us an alternative to her kibble consumption. She has lost 6 pounds so far. I say stay in your lane and focus on the issue we brought her in for and don’t mention recurring issues unless you have a solution.
The staff was so kind to my new puppy Josie and the Veterinarian was great.
My dog Betty had an excellent visit to the pet hospital of Terrasanta. The office was clean and the staff was professional.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Susan! We are delighted that you had a great experience with The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta .

This place is one of the best vet experiences I've ever had, and we're super lucky that it is nearby for us! We took our pup for her spay, and they were very concise and clear with all of the pricing and information. I also felt that the cost was more than reasonable, especially for the care that we got. She is almost healed and didn't have any complications or issues. They're also great about getting medications we needed, such as the heartworm and flea/tick supply. Would highly recommend!
Very compassionate staff
We've been going here for years for our cats and they always do a great job at making sure our cats are very well taken care of.

We have been taking our cat to the clinic for a year and have always had an excellent experience.
From the friendly front desk team, vet nurses who truly cared for him to knowledgeable Dr D’Angelo, everyone has been fantastic. Homer was treated like a celebrity!

The pricing is clear and explained before hand. We also loved the app where we can book appointments easily.

I highly recommend them because while my dog was under during a procedure, they trimmed his nails, expressed his anal glands, and performed an otoscopic ear exam. I was happy that it was included. Nowadays, everything is extra. I was also extremely pleased the cost was reasonable even for surgery. I'm happy, Melvin is happy. You will be too!

Absolutely love this clinic and the staff. The staff is always warm and friendly. We’ve been to many vet hospital and no other hospital comes close. I take many of our cats here to see Dr. D’Angelo. There is no one I’d trust more.
Really appreciate the warmth and personality of the new veterinarian. Didn't catch his name but he was kind, knowledgeable & accomadating and spent time with our sweet cat, Raleigh. Thank you.

The front desk personnel, vet techs and doctors were all outstanding and very compassionate. I unfortunately had a not so great situation and they made it the best they could with their kindness. Thank you! I’ll
Always a trusted place to take our pet Beni, knowing he'll receive caring professional care.
Very nice staff!! Dr  D’Angelo is the best !
Dr d’angelo was extremely thorough. She made us feel right at home. Her assistant, Sarah, was helpful and knowledgeable. It was the best pet visit I’ve ever had and I am a long time dog owner.

I have been taking my cat Marvin to them for a few years now. Recently I found out he was very sick and for a moment I thought I was going to have to put him down as he is a senior boy. Dr. D'Angelo, and Angela were absolutely amazing. …

We are so glad to have chosen The Pet Hospital of Tierrasanta for our two goldendoodles. We've had great experiences during every visit over the years thanks to the clinic's knowledgeable and caring staff! They take their time with our dogs and always follow up with us to check on them. Highly recommended!
